name: What is the typical step-by-step process during a full kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical step-by-step process during a full kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full remodel follows an orderly progression to protect finished surfaces and ensure structural integrity. Work begins with demolition and any custom framing to alter entryways or islands. Rough-in plumbing, gas lines, and electrical wiring follow immediately behind the framing. Next, the crew hangs, tapes, and finishes the drywall before applying primer. Once walls are prepped, cabinet installation begins, followed by countertop fabrication templates, tile backsplashes, finish flooring, and trim molding. The project wraps up with final plumbing fixtures, lighting, and interior paint touch-ups.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process moves from demolition and framing to rough plumbing and electrical, followed by drywall, cabinet installation, tile work, trim, and final fixture trim-out.
